test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two concentric circles drawn with the radius of inner circle 6 cm and outer circle radius 50% more than inner circle. What is the area of the annulus formed between two circles?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of inner circle = 6 cm.

Radius of outer circle = 50% more than the inner circle = 6 + 0.5 × 6 = 9 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Area of a circle = πr²

Area of annulus = Area of outer circle - Area of inner circle

**Calculation:**

Area of inner circle = π × 6² = 36π cm²

Area of outer circle = π × 9² = 81π cm²

Area of annulus = 81π - 36π

⇒ Area of annulus = 45π

⇒ Area of annulus = 45 × (22)/(7)

⇒ Area of annulus = (990)/(7) cm²

**The area of the annulus formed between two circles is frac{{990}}{7} cm².**
